  "text": "MSSR-owned operational skills have one canonical bundled source for the five names in `config/first-party-skills.json`. Native, Codex-local, and OpenCode-local source providers discover that package with reserved-name precedence; a custom catalog may not reclaim one of those names as an editable owner. The package boundary does not imply loading every first-party skill on every task; required/on-demand/closing activation remains explicit. In 0.2.54 each root became a compact control plane and selected direct parent-owned references through its manifest; routing metadata/fixtures remained unchanged. The 0.2.55 maintenance follow-up makes progressive disclosure apply to reference units too: a compact root is not sufficient when a generic signal still selects one monolithic reference, so broad anomaly evidence loads only a compact index and detailed procedures require conjunctive stage/intent selectors. The v1 distribution gate proves package dry-run, routing/context selection, safe opt-in junction migration and audit without publishing externally.",
